title: dpp-index-registration@1
description: The request an application's wallet signs to register its publisher key with an index (spec/services.md section 2). Canonical form: object keys sorted by code point, no whitespace, string values only. The signature is DER ECDSA over SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the request without the signature property, by the BRC-42 child of publisherKey for protocol [1, 'dpp index registration v1'], key identifier indexUrl and counterparty 'anyone' (the BRC-100 createSignature operation), so the verification key derives from the request alone and a request signed for one index is useless at another.

indexUrl.description: The index's public address as the application configured it. The index compares it with its own PUBLIC_URL, ignoring one trailing slash and host case.

publisherKey.description: The key the application's states are countersigned by: compressed, lower-case hex.

custodyProfile.description: The custody profile the application writes under, which must be the one the index declares in its capability document, for example managed-custody@2 or record-model-baseline@2.

label.description: The application's name for the operator's eyes: printable text, at most 128 bytes.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 with a timezone; an index accepts a request within its clock window, ten minutes by default.

signature.description: Canonical DER ECDSA, lower-case hex, by the derived key.
